    • pathBetween

      public com.pedropathing.paths.Path pathBetween(com.pedropathing.geometry.Pose startPose, com.pedropathing.geometry.Pose endPose, HeadingInterpolationType headingInterpolationType)
      Create BezierLine Path using the passed startPose, endPose, and headingInterpolationType. The headings come from the start and end Pose headings. Paths are cached, so it is ok to call this method repeatedly.
      Parameters:
      startPose - start Pose of BezierLine
      endPose - end Pose of BezierLine
      headingInterpolationType - LINEAR, TANGENT, CONSTANT
      Returns:
      Path
